meta.evaluation_status: Exploratory; did not pass all preregistered gates
meta.reality_check: Research only. These models use no betting market prices and have not shown an advantage over the market. Current injuries are shown for context; the original forecast does not use them.

glossary.text: How often a team wins games like this one, according to the six models combined. 60% means about 6 wins in 10 such games.
Six different statistical methods trained on the same past games. They often agree because they see the same inputs, so 6 of 6 agreeing is not 100%.
How many of the six models lean toward each team. A 3-3 vote is a tie; the win chance comes from the combination method, not the vote.
From a separate score model, not a sportsbook. The spread is the expected winning margin; the total is both teams' points combined.
8 in 10 games like this land inside the shown range. The chart is a smooth curve drawn through the score model's saved range.
Forecasts from changed versions of the models, saved for testing. None has passed its tests yet, so none changes the headline.
Players listed on the latest saved injury check. The original forecast does not use them.
